text: What if a cat bit you... and you got cat powers?
Step one: pet a cat that has clearly said no.
asr: Step 1, petacat that has clearly said no.

text: Chomp!
Quick reality check! A real cat bite won't give you powers. It gives you an infection. Please see a doctor.
But this is a what-if. So: day one. You wake up, look in the mirror, and... ears! Two extra ears. On top.
asr: But this is a what if so day one you wake up look in the mirror and ears to extra ears on top

text: Also a tail. Nobody asked for the tail.
Power number one: night vision! Cats can see in light about six times dimmer than you need.
Behind the eye there's a mirror layer that bounces light back for a second try. That's why cat eyes glow in photos.
So at three in the morning, in total darkness, you can finally find the TV remote. Hero stuff.
Power number two: you always land on your feet!
Cats twist in mid-air, head first, then the body, like a spring unwinding. They can do it from a fall of about thirty centimeters.
asr: Cats twist in mid-air headfirst then the body like a spring unwinding. They can do it from a fall of about 30 centimeters.

text: You fall off a ladder? Ta-da! The paint bucket? Not so lucky.
asr: You fall off a ladder, tada, the paint bucket, not so lucky.

text: Power number three: the jump! A cat can leap up to five times its own height.
You're one point eight meters tall. Times five... that's nine meters. A two-story roof. From standing!
asr: You're 1.8 meters tall, times 5, that's 9 meters, a 2-story roof from standing.

text: Your neighbors have questions.
Power number four: super hearing! You hear sounds up to twenty thousand hertz. A cat? Up to sixty-four thousand.
asr: Power number four superhearing you hear sounds up to 20,000 hertz, a cat up to 64,000.

text: You can hear a mouse in the walls. And the neighbor's microwave. And your fridge. All day. Every day.
Here's the catch. Cat powers come with cat habits.
Side effect one: things on edges must fall. Your boss's mug is on the edge of the desk. You look at it. It looks at you.
You don't know why you did it. You would do it again.
Side effect two: cats can't taste sweet. The gene is broken. So birthday cake now tastes like... wet bread.
asr: Side effect too, cats can't taste sweet. The gene is broken, so birthday cake now tastes like wet bread.

text: And the big one. Cats sleep twelve to sixteen hours a day. So do you now.
asr: And the big one, cat sleep 12 to 16 hours a day, so do you now.

text: A superhero shift is eight hours. You are awake for eight hours. Total.
asr: The superhero shift is 8 hours. You are awake for 8 hours total.

text: The city calls for Meow Man. Meow Man is in a box. In a sunbeam. Do not disturb.
asr: The city calls for meow man, meow man is in a box, and a sunbeam do not disturb.

text: Day thirty. Mr. Biscuits bit your boss too. The city now has two Meow Men.
Both asleep. The cat is fine.
Next time: what if a dog licked you?
